notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); the hardware backend was never opened, imported or run, and no hardware run is claimed. It is R1, so the loader does not refuse a model-authored hardware backend at this risk (that refusal applies at R2 and R3); a human must still review the package before hardware use. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

Recon: both card entry symbols exist at the pinned commit, hantek1008:Hantek1008Raw at hantek1008.py:37 and hantek1008:Hantek1008 at hantek1008.py:683. The package uses Hantek1008 as native, which inherits every method the driver calls. The upstream builds each command as a binary frame in __send_cmd (hantek1008.py:156-175), so a SerialDriver or ScpiDriver command table cannot express it; the card's decision is direct-driver. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the helper hint PythonObjectDriver is not used. The package is a direct Driver because it needs five x-cap actions with inline output schemas, including a safe-state action and an e-stop, which the config-only family table cannot express. The card's candidate classes were checked with catalog show: cap.sensing.read.v1 binds sensor kinds, and cap.device.configure.v1 is a readback-backed state write; neither fits a generator command with no getter. The other read hints are not bound: get_vscale is the per-channel form of get_vscales, get_zero_offsets is the vscale-keyed dict form of the per-channel zero-offset read, and get_used_zero_offsets_shift_compensation_method describes a constructor option that no public setter changes.

Covered: reads of active_channels, vertical_scales, zero_offsets, paused and generator_waveform_max_length; actions that switch the generator outputs on or off, set the generator speed, upload a waveform, start or stop the pause thread, and disable the generator as the safe state. The e-stop calls Hantek1008.set_generator_on(False) after the runtime latches; the safe-state action calls the same method.

NOT COVERED: the sample arrays of request_samples_roll_mode and request_samples_burst_mode (hantek1008.py:402-520), which are the oscilloscope capture path; the standard carries their scalar settings and the generator commands, not those arrays. Also not covered: the constructor-only settings (time division, trigger channel/slope/level, vertical-scale and active-channel selection) because the clone has no public setters for them; the calibration routine and correction data; and the hardware path. The generator has no upstream getter, so its actions return the value they commanded, not a device readback.

G4 warnings (2): both are REF_VALUE because the gate's number parser does not read the forms the clone writes. x-cap.mfg92.set_generator_speed.v1 cites the exact assertion at hantek1008.py:551, which writes 750_000 with an underscore; no line of the clone states 750000 in plain decimal. x-cap.mfg92.set_generator_waveform.v1 cites the exact assertion at hantek1008.py:577, which writes the upper bound in binary as 0b1111_1111 (255); the only plain 255 in the clone is an unrelated command-id assertion at hantek1008.py:165, so citing it would be wrong. Both warnings are listed here instead of weakening or mis-citing the bound.

Safety: the package declares R1, the card floor, and no class elevates it. The generator drives eight digital outputs; the clone states no output voltage, current or load, so no electrical limit is invented. The e-stop is a software stop of the generator outputs, not a safety-rated function; no independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone, so estop_physical_ref is not set (SAFE-045 applies at R2 and above). The physical e-stop and the operator stay authoritative.

Fake: every number in fake.py is placeholder test data, marked with # placeholder; the fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording of a device. fixtures/conformance.json supplies only valid, alternate and out-of-envelope inputs for the extension actions, not facts.

Catalogue gaps: the five extension ids above are requested because no catalogue class binds a waveform or pattern generator with no readback; see catalogue_requests.
